answer: In an AI-managed orchard, agents reporting an ember or a gale must lock collateral, and their voting weight is proportional to that stake, not their number of accounts. Splitting one deposit among a thousand identities therefore buys no extra influence. Each report is signed; two incompatible votes for the same decision provide proof that triggers slashing. An attacker must tie up real capital to gain weight and risks losing it by equivocating.
